FAtomPred.NAME_EQ takes only a literal string_value (no referent slot; FAtom.referent is IS_ATTACHED_TO-only), NAME_CHOSEN needs a CHOOSE_NAME pick, and nothing binds the targeted creature's name for later filters. Needed: a name-equality predicate against a referent object (e.g. NAME_EQ with referent='target'). The target (opponent's creature, CMC_LE 2), the exiles and the reveal are otherwise expressible.
